title: Idempotency record
description: Idempotency fragment. The record key is (principal, environment, operation, idempotency_key); the record stores the request hash (RFC 8785 JCS SHA-256 of the request body) and the original response, retained at least 7 days. Same key + same hash returns the original response; same key + different hash fails with IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED.

response.description: The original response returned for every replay.

idempotency_key.description: Client-chosen key, 1-128 characters from [A-Za-z0-9_-], required on every state-changing operation.

derived_key.description: Proxied-call key: 'lt_' + lowercase hex SHA-256 of 'caller_identity|env|tool|idempotency_key' (UTF-8). Fits idempotency_key.

request_hash.description: SHA-256 of the RFC 8785 canonical request body (transport headers such as the caller block excluded).
